posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
Today I want to show you something I never saw anywhere else

But I see them all over Portugal (and apparently Spain too)

They're giant warehouses in the middle of nowhere with big red signs saying MEGA CHINA, HIPER CHINA, MAXI CHINA, or even GRANDE CHINA

They're shops by Chinese immigrants from a single place in China, the Zheijang province (where Alibaba is also from)

The story is that they came to Southern Europe in the 1990s and 2000s and built these shops

They started as small shops but then during the financial crisis in 2008, there was suddenly lots of super cheap warehouses from bankrupt Portuguese companies so they took them over and turned their tiny shops into massive stores

Now they're anything but small, they're MEGA CHINA

It's a tight family run network with a few distribution hubs that supply the shops and in the hubs then get supplied by container ships from China. Way more advanced than I first thought

China is everywhere, even in the middle of nowhere in Portugal!

(Part 2 in reply)
posts.text_zh:
今天想给你们看一样我别处从没见过的东西

但在葡萄牙到处都能看到（西班牙好像也有）

荒郊野外矗立着巨型仓库，大红招牌写着 MEGA CHINA、HIPER CHINA、MAXI CHINA，甚至 GRANDE CHINA

它们是由来自中国同一地方——浙江省（阿里巴巴也来自那里）的中国移民开设的商店

故事是：他们在 1990 年代和 2000 年代来到南欧，开起了这些店

起初是小店，但 2008 年金融危机时，突然出现大量来自破产葡萄牙公司的超便宜仓库，他们就接手了，把小店变成了巨型商场

现在一点也不小了，是 MEGA CHINA

这是一个紧密的家族运营网络，有几个配送中心给各店供货，配送中心再由从中国来的集装箱船供货。比我最初想的先进得多

中国无处不在，连葡萄牙荒郊野外都有！

（Part 2 在回复里）

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
Prepping is now mainstream

With AI-assisted cyberattacks on infrastructure now the preppers turned out to be right

Even the governments recently started recommend everyone to prep now:

US, UK, France, Ireland, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, Spain, Finland, Denmark and EU recommend 3 days of water and food

Norway, Sweden, Estonia recommend 7 days of water and food

Germany recommends 10 days of water and food

I personally would add if you can get batteries and solar that helps a lot
posts.text_zh:
储备物资（prepping）现在成了主流

有了 AI 辅助的对基础设施网络攻击，预备派被证明是对的

连各国政府最近也开始建议人人储备：

美国、英国、法国、爱尔兰、荷兰、比利时、葡萄牙、西班牙、芬兰、丹麦和欧盟建议储备 3 天的水和食物

挪威、瑞典、爱沙尼亚建议 7 天的水和食物

德国建议 10 天的水和食物

我个人还会加上：如果能搞到电池和太阳能，会很有帮助
posts.quoted_text: a concerning number of my friends have become very interested in prepping

posts.text:
Some people say they don't believe these numbers

So calculate it for yourself:

~115 deaths ÷ ~35M high speed train trips
=
1 in 300,000 is the statistical odds of death per trip in a Spanish high speed train this year

You can then argue "why do you cherry pick only this year", well because it happened this year! It's new information and you have 2 highly similar fatal accidents happening in one year meaning the probability that's random is almost zero

It's like saying after the 737 Max crashes that killed 346 people in 2018/2019

"That's just a random statistical oddity, I'll board the next one immediately"

Of course you wouldn't

What you'd do is board none at all until it's fully investigated why they crashed and the cause is solved, like the FAA did exactly by grounding them

To all the Spanish nationalist keyboard warriors attacking me instead of their government:

Pivot your energy to prosecuting the people responsible for killing 100+ innocent people this year instead of shooting the messenger!

When we're reaching post-AGI where money becomes useless and almost everything free
